game_title: Return Or Print – Chimney Roofs Streak
game_concept: A card battler set in Snowy Hold – Chimney Roofs, snowy chimney rooftops: the sled courier must handle blizzard sprites while practicing functions. Core idea – Return Or Print: Decide whether to return or print and see why only return passes data on.
theme: Snowy Hold – Chimney Roofs: snowy chimney rooftops
core_gameplay_loop: In Chimney Roofs, repeat each round: Decide whether to return or print and see why only return passes data on. Each round poses one decision; a wrong answer breaks the streak. Then check the court_score value and advance.
secondary_mechanics: Bonus coins for fast correct moves
player_objective: Chain 12 consecutive correct decisions about court_score to power up the sled courier and open the larder door.
controls: Touch: tap tiles or buttons to choose values, swipe to move, long-press for a hint.
lose_condition: lives reach 0 (each wrong decision costs a life and resets the streak).
learning_alignment: Week 6 – Functions | Level 6 (applied tier): Return Or Print
assets_style: cozy pixel-art snow town: icy blue rooftops, frosted pines, warm lantern glow; flat Kenney-style sprites; soft bells, wind howls and cozy hearth crackle
